queueUnit: Physical artifact work group; expanded ZIP/chunk semantic sources retain their separate catalog and result counts. Completed groups retain their buffer reservation until the single store callback finishes.
control: G06 accepted correct serial implementation; absent until G06, no speedup claim
measurementRule: Compare identical source/corpus/configuration, semantic output, diagnostics, coverage and completeness before timing. Retain every sample; report median and observed maximum, not p95 from these sample counts.
scope: Initial capacities, to be implemented and tested by owning gates. Buffer is a global lease budget, not RSS; sessions/plans have separate bounds. L scan capacity does not promise one full-L JSON session.
changeRule: Any revised capacity or corpus-specific threshold is versioned and frozen before the affected measurement/optimization; do not relax after seeing a failed result. G07 must include full G06 workflow scenarios as well as synthetic capacity corpora.
